author: Bodostock
text:
Madmoney wrote: AUDUSD (quick sell)

Hi, mate, I was actually looking to long this early the morning.

But it was already 3am on my side, i need to sleep so i actually placed a pending limit long order somewhere within your red box.

Too bad, price actually halted just around where your chart was showing for the next few hours and kaboomed up on this morning news!

Do you know why price halted at the last price before it reversed up?

This is the one of the parts on compression i could hardly understand in terms of entry level in such scenario.

Looking at your M15 tf, it seemed at least to me that there was compression consuming the demand and price can go down till the next unconsumed demand which should be within your red box.

Even going into M1 tf, the compression was clear and price did engulfed into the CP zone but there were quite a number of times like such scenario that as price engulfed the CP zone, it was reversed up/down halfway.

i could hardly take chance to trade on such pattern even if i am waking up and stay on the screen.
